final_candidates.decision_summary: Q54 lies within the basic ARM/TAR-binding region, and Arg substitution increases positive charge without deleting a conserved Arg/Lys. This is the most plausible direct route to stronger TAR engagement and Tat transactivation, though specificity risk remains.

Q60 is immediately adjacent to the ARM in the Gln-rich auxiliary region, so added Arg may enhance electrostatic interactions with RNA or cofactors. It is slightly less central than Q54R and therefore ranked lower.
G48 directly precedes the R49-start basic domain, and G48R could extend the cationic RNA-binding surface. Proximity to the ARM creates higher risk of altering TAR specificity, so confidence is lower.

stop_reason.detail: Self-iteration reached a stable Top-3 under LLM-only constraints with no additional evidence tools to consult.
